pulse.currentFocus: S354 proved Cloudflare Web Analytics works end to end (beacon, report and ingestion verified; the seven-day zero was real traffic; two wrong fixes reverted unshipped), disclosed it on /privacy/, and closed a release-proof strand exposed by modeling one generator.
pulse.nextMilestone: Continue agent items: 19 generators to model, publisher resync gate, held-run doctor probe, local mobile preview default; watch human page loads now that analytics is proven.
blockers: Edge uptime sampler cannot run: Workers Free caps the account at 5 cron triggers and all five belong to other projects (seamline, studio-ops-cron, veilos, velaxis-proxy x2). Cloudflare error 10072. Needs a founder to free a slot or move to Workers Paid (billing, CANON-019).
604 pre-S349 uptime rows remain unresolvable — a challenge and a real edge outage are indistinguishable in them now the shape is gone. They are labelled, never re-scored, and age out naturally.
Identity/provider acceptance and scoped credential-owner reconciliation remain unresolved independently of this release.
Human signup acceptance, newsletter deployment/arming, Desk cadence, public-member-data, and immutable warm-origin choices remain unobserved or undecided.
Field-vitals freshness requires a genuinely fresh RUM cohort; local lab evidence deliberately abstains.

[skip ci] publishers still do not cascade every derived artifact: 20 proof-surface generators are outside the evidence graph (tracked as coverage baseline 20), so the cascade gate cannot see them yet.

now: [S354][FOUNDER DIRECTIVE] Founder-owned items deferred. Passkey sign-in, signup walkthrough, public member data, newsletter arming, Desk cadence, warm-origin, Workers Paid and the small confirmations wait until the founder picks them up; agent-owned items continue.

[S352][SIL][CI/P2] Gate staged-but-unmodeled outputs — SHIPPED S353. The "67/67 modeled" ratchet only read `build:check:steps`; 20 generators checked inside `check-proof-surface` were invisible. Coverage now parses that list too: 72/92 modeled, baseline 20, may only fall.

[S353][SIL:1][CI/P2] Model the proof-surface generators, highest-risk first — 19 left. S354 modeled `build-release-dependencies` (and its missing `release-proof` edge, which exposed a real weekly-maintenance strand, now closed). Start with `build-release-dependencies` (weekly-maintenance stages its output). Read each generator for REAL sources, add the node, `--update` to lower the baseline.

[S353][SIL][OBS/P2] Verify the first Vault Narrative run after the S353 fix publishes a dispatch. Expect `[vault-narrative] wrote … (anchor:…)` and `--check-fresh` green; if it rejects, the log now prints the rejected text.

[S352][SIL][OBS/P1] Ship the sampler RPC entrypoint on Ark acceptance. Ark `01K2EQ77M9F29A0EC9619EA4BC` asks studio-ops to reuse `studio-ops-cron` */30 via a service binding. The website half needs a node-side `cloudflare:workers` shim for the unit tests.

[S351][OBS/P0 · FOUNDER DECISION] Free a cron slot, or move the account to Workers Paid. S352: an agent-side third option went to studio-ops via Ark (row above); this row closes if studio-ops accepts. This is the single thing standing between the studio and ever observing its own edge, and it is now a one-sentence decision rather than an investigation. Five of five free-plan cron triggers are in use by other projects. Retiring one is a live change to that project (founder call); Workers Paid raises the cap to 1,000 and is a billing action reserved to a human under CANON-019. Everything downstream is already built, deployed and verified — namespace, binding, handler, drain, 12/12 drain self-tests.

[S351][CI/P1] The `[skip ci]` publishers still do not cascade their derived artifacts. `b67c283d1 feat(desk): publish the latenight edition [skip ci]` added news pages plus art and changed `index.html` at 22:20
next: [S348][SIL][NEWS/AI/P1] Claim-evidence relationship map + agent critique packet — DONE. Every Desk story now links to a deterministic `critique.json` argument map joining stable fact receipts, stances, predictions, and hash-bound visual evidence. Unsupported claims stay explicitly `unlinked`; orphan cross-references fail closed; no runtime model call is made.
